Name: Frog Friends (Trinket Companion)
Author: emjess
Description:
FROGGIES! 

Quick & simple mod to retexture the trinket frogs to be a little more froggy-shaped and natural coloured. Entirely motivated by my love of collecting the frog eggs and putting them in fish tanks as my little pets. 

(the colours took SO long, I'm still not super happy with them, but I'm over it)

Requires Content Patcher only. Not compatible with other frog recolours. Doesn't change the chances of getting any particular colour, the mechanics are the same as base game.
